notes.currency_note: QBE reports in USD despite being ASX-listed. All figures in US$M.
notes.revenue: Insurance revenue = 10,875 US$M. This is the insurance-specific top-line (premium income after reinsurance adjustments). The Appendix 4D confirms 'Revenue from ordinary activities = US$10,875M'. Note 1 in Appendix 4D clarifies this refers to insurance revenue with reinsurance income of US$1,745M.
notes.ebit: Profit before income tax = 1,334. The income statement shows: Insurance operating result (988) + insurance finance items + investment income/expenses + other items → Insurance profit (1,105) → Profit before income tax (1,334). Income tax expense = (308).
notes.np_attributable: Profit after income tax attributable to ordinary equity holders of the Company = 1,022. Non-controlling interests = 4.
notes.capex: PP&E capex = (9) US$M — tiny for an insurer. Intangible asset purchases = (36) are separate. Wide tolerance (10%) because the value is small and rounding matters more.
notes.net_debt: Borrowings from balance sheet = 3,679 (subordinated debt). Cash = 2,124. net_debt = 1,555. Insurance contract liabilities (30,745) are NOT financial debt.
notes.shares_outstanding: 1,510 millions = 1,510,000,000 from Note 4.3.1. Share count is in millions in the note — extraction must convert to absolute count.
